description: Use this when the user asks for an existing coach-built training program for their sport or goal, for example a structured volleyball program. It returns up to five matching Phorme programs, each with a sample session from its first week that the user can try now and where to find it in the Phorme app. Every result is a program a member can train in the Phorme app today. It changes nothing, shows no prices and starts no purchase. Results are ordered by fit and never by commission.

creator.description: Coach or creator name, only if the user named one.

name: search_phorme_programs

programs.description: Matching programs, best fit first, each with title, coach, weeks, sample_session and access.
